decisions.reason: The guided historic mill tour has accumulated sunk costs and visible public commitment since 2018, and any weak results can still be attributed to temporary factors, so management persists with it.

Despite lower public prominence, the sweet pastry represents sunk investment and continuing responsibility, and earlier decisions to keep it call for justification, so management keeps it rather than withdraw prematurely.
The crusty farmhouse bread has less accumulated commitment and no public flagship status, making withdrawal more plausible, but current investment and lack of clear failure still favor keeping it.
As a flagship with its own page and a gold award, the poppy seed Christmas stollen is central and highly visible, so management strongly escalates commitment to it.
The premium Christmas stollen's gold award and public mention create commitment, though slightly less central than the flagship, so drop probability remains very low.
